source.quote: Let C <= min{M, N}. Suppose the distributions of arm rewards are Bernoulli and suppose the user at round t is sampled independently from a distribution P_N. ... Then inf sup Reg(T) >= 0.02(R_1+R_2), where R_1 = sum_n E[min{sqrt(C T_n), T_n}], R_2 = sum_c E[min{sqrt(M T_c), T_c}].
